title: Analysis of stress distribution around total hip stems custom-designed for the standardized Asian femur configuration.
first_author_affiliation: Hemorheology Research Institute, Chonbuk National University , Jeonju , Chonbuk , South Korea.

corresponding_authors.name: Cheol Sang Kim
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Bionanosystem Engineering (BK21 Plus Program), Chonbuk National University , Jeonju , Chonbuk , South Korea ; Division of Mechanical Design Engineering, Chonbuk National University , Jeonju , Chonbuk , South Korea.

relevance_to_user: 本文直接研究髋关节假体应力遮挡，但缺乏微动分析和实验验证，且基于标准亚洲人股骨几何，非患者特异性。
why_not_core: No micromotion analysis, no intact vs implanted comparison, no experimental validation, only FE simulation without uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究定制型髋关节假体对亚洲人股骨应力遮挡的影响。
summary_zh.method: 基于标准亚洲股骨几何设计四种假体，采用有限元法分析骨-假体界面应力分布。
summary_zh.result: 近端内侧带阶梯沟槽的设计应力遮挡最小，应力分布最大。
summary_zh.validation: 有限元仿真分析，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate stress shielding around custom-fitted hip implants designed for the standard Asian femur geometry.
summary_en.method: Four custom stem designs were analyzed using finite element method under 1750 N loading on a standard Asian femur model.
summary_en.result: The stepped groove design in the proximal-medial region showed the highest principal stress distribution and minimized stress shielding.
summary_en.validation: Finite element simulation without experimental or clinical validation.
